sections.title: Host invocation context
sections.summary: This section documents the typed `bunzai.context.invocation.resources` property. It is a read-only array of at most 16 host-selected resource refs covered by the package's approved grants, passed separately from command input. It is not filtered for one operation: the broker rechecks and narrows the resources against each exact operation grant before access. Desktop and Browser command menus attach Library staged refs or the Workbench active piece. Terminal has no current-piece or `--on` selector; handlers use explicit operation selectors where available. This distinction keeps examples honest about host support and authority.
